visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a black screen displaying white text, transitioning into a bright indoor environment. A young male with dark hair, styled in a modern cut, looks directly down into the camera lens with a surprised and happy expression. He is wearing a white button-down shirt and a maroon and white patterned scarf. (2) The scene shifts to a medium full shot where the man stands in a studio-like room with light wood paneled walls and industrial ceilings. He excitedly holds a large, black Chanel shopping box tied with white ribbons and a white camellia flower. An abstract painting hangs on the wall to his right. (3) He proceeds to unbox the item, revealing a large black quilted denim tote bag with gold chain straps and a prominent interlocking CC logo. He holds the bag up to the camera, demonstrating its size and material texture while wearing dark, quilted trousers that complement the bag's aesthetic. (4) The creator then demonstrates the bag's capacity by placing several items inside: a white reusable water bottle, a paperback book, a black notebook, a folded scarf, sunglasses in a case, and a small black camera. He wears the bag on his shoulder to show how it fits against the body during movement. (5) In a close-up phase, he highlights a specific design feature: a small, detachable black inner pouch. He shows how it connects to the main bag and suggests its use as a separate clutch. The lighting is bright and even, emphasizing the details of the product.
